code:
def task(robot):
    cans = robot.look()
    if len(cans) < 2:
        robot.say("I need at least two cans to give you.")
        return

    can1 = cans[0]
    can2 = None
    for can in cans:
        if can['id'] != can1['id'] and can['colour'] != can1['colour']:
            can2 = can
            break

    if can2 is None:
        robot.say("I can only find cans of the same color.")
        return

    robot.pick(can1['id'])
    robot.say("Here is a can.")
    robot.give()

    robot.pick(can2['id'])
    robot.say("And here is another one of a different color.")
    robot.give()
